{{External|rs=Grimy guam|rsc=Herb (Guam leaf)}} {{Otheruses|the grimy herb|the cleaned herb|Guam leaf}} {{Infobox Item |name = Grimy guam leaf |image = [[File:Grimy guam leaf.png]] |release = [[27 February]] [[2002]] |update = Latest RuneScape News (27 February 2002) |members = Yes |quest = No |tradeable = Yes |equipable = No |stackable = No |noteable = Yes |options = Clean, Drop |examine = It needs cleaning. |value = 13 |weight = 0.007 |respawn = 200 |exchange = Yes |id = 199 }} [[File:Grimy guam leaf detail.png|left|170px]] A '''grimy guam leaf''' is a [[herb]] that can be cleaned, requiring 3 [[Herblore]], and yielding a [[guam leaf]] and 2.5 Herblore [[experience]]. Grimy guam leaves can be harvested from [[herb patch]]es after planting a [[guam seed]], requiring 9 [[Farming]]. Guam leaves are used to make [[Attack potion]]s, [[Guthix rest]]s, and [[guam tar]]. A grimy guam leaf spawns in the [[Deep Wilderness Dungeon]].
